'''Ness''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]] of the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Along with the rest of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], the planet lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], and it occupied the first [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Darlo/Legends|Darlo]]. Its surface consisted of [[Magma/Legends|molten rock]], and the planet featured a [[Temperature/Legends|searing hot]] environment.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ness was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA" />
